  • Constructor Details

    • PhysicsSphere

      public PhysicsSphere(float radius, org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f center, float mass, org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3D graphics, Integrator integrator, float restitution, float friction, float rollFriction)
      Creates a new rigid body sphere for a physics simulation. The created sphere will have the given properties and be linked to the given Component3D.
      Parameters:
      radius - the radius of the sphere.
      center - the center of the sphere in world coordinates.
      mass - the sphere's mass in kilograms.
      graphics - the Component3D that the sphere updates when it's state is updated.
      integrator - the integrator to use for time integration.

  • Method Details

    • collide

      public void collide(Collideable c, Vector<Contact> contacts)
      Checks collision between the sphere and a collideable of unknown type. Enables the use of double dispatch for collision testing different collideables against each other. Just calls c.collideSphere(this, contacts).
      Specified by:
      collide in interface Collideable
      Parameters:
      c - the object implementing Collideable to test for overlap against.
      contacts - a Vector of Contact objects to store any occuring contacts in.

    • collideSphere

      public void collideSphere(PhysicsSphere sphere, Vector<Contact> contacts)
      Tests a sphere for overlap against another sphere. Will not test for separation at the contact, just determine if there is a contact and if so the contacts point in world coordinates and the contact normal. Adds any contact found in the supplied Vector.
      Specified by:
      collideSphere in interface Collideable
      Parameters:
      sphere - the sphere to test for intersection against
      contacts - a Vector in which to store the contact that is found.

    • applyImpulse

      public void applyImpulse(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f impulse, org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f point)
      Applies a Newtonian impulse at a given point to this sphere. The impulse (instant velocity change) is applied at the given point as if it was inside the sphere.
      Specified by:
      applyImpulse in interface Collideable
      Overrides:
      applyImpulse in class PhysicsBody
      Parameters:
      impulse - a vector giving the size and direction of the impulse.
      point - the point in world coordinates at which the impulse is applied.
